create_LinearRegression_model: create a LinearRegression PyTorch module with learnable parameters a and b for simple linear regression
create_PersonalizedLinearRegression_mode: create a PersonalizedLinearRegression model that extends LinearRegression with user-private module support for federated learning
create_FCModel: create a fully connected neural network model with three linear layers of sizes 10 to 5 to 3 to 1
